close_reason: Added std::fmt::Display impls for LocalDateTime, Duration, SignedDuration that emit the bare wire string (matching RFC 8984 §1.4.5/.6/.7). format!("{dt}") now compiles. Added scalar_newtypes_display_as_wire_string test confirming all three. cargo test + clippy clean.
description:
src/lib.rs:43, 68, 94 define LocalDateTime, Duration, SignedDuration as transparent String newtypes with From<String>, From<&str>, AsRef<str> only.

Comparison points:
- jmap-types::{Id, UTCDate, Date, State} use the impl_string_newtype! macro (crate-jmap-types/src/id.rs:72-116) which generates Display, From<String>, From<&str>, AsRef<str>, PartialEq<str>, PartialEq<&str>, std::borrow::Borrow<str>, and into_inner(). That is the foundation canonical pattern.
- jmap-jscontact-types::JsContactId (crate-jmap-jscontact-types/src/lib.rs:99-115) has the same minimal set as the new newtypes here (From<String>, From<&str>, AsRef<str>) — matches the sibling extension-types pattern.

So the new newtypes match the sibling jscontact pattern but diverge from the canonical foundation pattern. Consequence at consumer sites:

- format!("until={}", rule.until.as_ref().map(|d| d.as_ref()).unwrap_or("")) — three method calls and an unwrap to render a string, whereas with Display it would be format!("until={}", rule.until.as_deref().unwrap_or(...)) or format!("until={}", rule.until.as_ref()...).
- error messages that interpolate a Duration require .as_ref() boilerplate at every site.
- no PartialEq<str> means tests like assert_eq!(rule.until.as_ref(), Some("2024-12-31T23:59:59".into())) must construct a LocalDateTime to compare, or compare on .as_ref().

This is not a correctness issue. It is a usability friction that will accumulate across every consumer call site. Two options:

(a) Promote the impl_string_newtype! macro from jmap-types to either a shared crate or duplicate it here — but jscontact already chose the minimal pattern, so this would create a divergence.

(b) Add Display + PartialEq<str> + PartialEq<&str> + Borrow<str> + into_inner() to LocalDateTime, Duration, SignedDuration without macroizing — closes the usability gap with localized code.

(c) Accept the friction as the cost of matching the jscontact sibling pattern, and file a workspace-API epic to harmonize the newtype impl set across all *-types crates.

Recommendation: (c) — newtype-impl coverage is a workspace-wide canonical-template question, not a per-crate question. File the question on a new bead under JMAP workspace-API epic, not as a per-crate fix.
title: LocalDateTime/Duration/SignedDuration missing Display impl: format!() interpolation becomes ergonomically awkward
